question: Where can I get a list of solar PV projects currently in permitting in France, with location, capacity (MW), developer, permitting stage and date?

answer.summary: No national list gives location, MW, developer, stage and date together. The best official source is the State portal Projets-Environnement (open API, newest record 2026-11-24): about 1,182 PV-related file records, 826 with geometry, with procedure type and links to study PDFs, but the developer field is empty and capacity is only in text. Developer and stage dates must be read in the PDFs (study cover page, MRAe opinion, prefectoral decision). Departmental layers (Hautes-Pyrénées) and DGEC auction lists cover subsets.
main_caveats: Projets-Environnement indexes documents, not permits: dc_date is the portal publication date and one project can be several records.
Maître d'ouvrage is empty for all 1,182 PV records; capacity is free text and may be MWc or connection MW.
Stage must be separated: impact-assessment opinion, permis de construire, works and auction award are different events in different documents.
Rooftop and carport PV and projects below the assessment threshold are not in the portal; no national list covers them.
answer.confidence_reason: Portal fields and counts were tested on 2026-11-25 and one project was followed to its PDF; no national list exists as far as checked, but prefectures and MRAe sites were only sampled.

how_to_use.example_result: total_count 729 (title search). First record: recordsid 2026N29105, dc_type ["Permis de construire"], dc_date 2026-11-24T10:52:14+00:00, title "…centrale photovoltaïque d'une puissance de 139 MWc…", geo_point_2d lon 1.602022 lat 46.597321.
steps: Download the full table with https://www.projets-environnement.gouv.fr/api/explore/v2.1/catalog/datasets/projets-environnement-diffusion/exports/json (about 25 MB, 6,502 records, about 3 s).
Select PV records by regex over dc_title, descriptif_du_projet, dc_subject_category and dc_subject_theme (1,182 matches on 2026-11-25; the API search on dc_title alone returns 729).
Extract MWc/MW from the text with a regex; the field exists in only about 455 PV records and may mix MWc and connection MW.
For the developer open the Resume_non_technique or Etude_impact PDF (cover page 'MAITRE D'OUVRAGE') or dc_relation_websiteowner.
For the stage use dc_type plus date_de_la_prefecture and dc_relation_decision; if absent, treat the file as a pending application.
Group records that share the same project title: one project can appear in several records with different points.
reading_traps: vp_creator_corporatename (Maîtrise d'ouvrage) is empty in all 1,182 PV records; dc_contributor_corporatename holds the study office or the placeholder 'Nom du bureau d'étude' (449 records).
dc_date is a portal date; the 139 MWc file was published 2026-11-24 but its study is dated 17/10/2024.
The same 139 MWc project appears as five records (2026N29105, N29110, N29113, N29115, N29117) with five different points.
vp_status describes the public consultation, not the building permit.
356 PV records have no geometry; 372 have multipolygons and 449 points, mixed within one project.

problems: Developer (maîtrise d'ouvrage) field empty for every PV record; capacity only in free text.
Catalogue 'modified' date (2018-03-22) does not reflect the daily content.

if_unstructured.summary: Developer, capacity and stage dates are in documents: the study cover page, the MRAe opinion and the prefectoral decision, all linked from Projets-Environnement.
recipe: Pull the portal table and select PV records (see the source steps).
For each record open the summary PDF; read the cover page for the maître d'ouvrage and search the text for MWc.
Read the MRAe opinion cover for the opinion date and the procedure; this dates the permit file but is not the permit.
If dc_relation_decision is present, open it: the prefectoral decision date is the authorisation or refusal event.
If absent, report the project as a pending application with the opinion date as last known event.
if_unstructured.location_method: Use the portal geometry; if missing, read the commune and cadastral references in the impact study.
if_unstructured.cross_with: Caparéseau poste data (connection capacity), DGEC auction lists (award stage), departmental GIS layers (status).
